entities.summary: James Benjamin Lampert was a United States Army Lieutenant General, Superintendent of the United States Military Academy (1963–1966), and early pioneer of nuclear weapons and nuclear power. Lampert was General Leslie Groves' executive officer as part of the Manhattan Project after World War II. Lampert was a grandson of Wisconsin U.S. representative Florian Lampert.
